sources_used.exhibit: Ex-99.1 (Q1 2026 earnings PR with ZEVASKYN update and ABO-701 in-licensing)

catalyst_rows.indication: Advanced prostate cancer (PSMA-targeted engineered T-cell therapy)
catalyst_rows.raw_text: Abeona expects to file an Investigational New Drug (IND) application and commence first-in-human studies with ABO-701 in the second half of 2027 while engaging a contract development and manufacturing organization for supply readiness in the meantime.

Steady increase in ZEVASKYN adoption with three patients completing treatment in the first quarter of 2026, one treatment to date in the second quarter, one biopsy currently in manufacturing process, and six additional patients expected to be biopsied in the second quarter, three of whom have biopsies scheduled.
Data presentation at SID2026 on sustained wound healing and long-term safety after one-time pz-cel application: 12-year case report and 5-year Phase 3 data.

extractor_notes.tier0_overlap_check: The ABO-701 in-licensing and 2H 2027 IND timeline is fresh (Q1 2026 transaction, $7M upfront payment), would not be in the 2024 10-K. ZEVASKYN Q2 2026 patient pipeline cadence and SID2026 presentation plan are also fresh. The Q1 2025 ZEVASKYN approval itself is older 10-K material.
